infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app requires location access to track patrol routes and record GPS coordinates during active duty.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location is required to continue recording patrol coordinates even when the app is minimized or the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is needed to capture profile photos for personnel identification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is required to select existing images for profile photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access may be used for voice notes during incident reporting.
